title: Earning Dollars on a Paid Repair Order: Points Redemptions and Late Payment — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
The earning dollars of a paid Service Accounts and Repair Orders repair order — the whole dollars on which points are earned — follow how the repair order was paid.

| How the paid repair order was paid | Earning dollars |
|---|---|
| A rewards redemption credit stands on it and its payment was received no more than 30 calendar days after its labor was closed | the paid labor and parts total less that rewards redemption credit, cents dropped, because the part paid with points earns nothing |
| Its payment was received more than 30 calendar days after its labor was closed | the customer-pay labor charges alone, cents dropped; parts earn nothing |
| Otherwise | the paid labor and parts total, cents dropped |

**Terms.**
- The paid repair order is the repair order of the latest payment received on the account; its payment date is the date of the latest payment received on it, and its labor was closed on the latest line date of its labor charges.
- The paid labor and parts total is its customer-pay labor and parts charges less the estimate overage, comeback and goodwill credits standing on it.
- The customer-pay labor charges alone are taken as charged, before any credit.

**Edges (hypothetical).** Labor closed 2 April: payment received 2 May is 30 days after; payment received 3 May is 31 days after.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Customer-pay labor 380.00, parts 145.50, no other credits:
- a 40.00 rewards redemption credit, paid 2 May: 485.50, so 485 dollars;
- paid 3 May: 380 dollars;
- no redemption, paid 2 May: 525 dollars.
